class Shape
  def base_area
    1
  end

  def never_called; end
end

module Printable
  def print_it; end

  def uses_host
    host_hook
  end
end

class Circle < Shape
  include Printable

  def area(scale)
    scale + base_area + print_it
  end

  def label
    uses_host
  end

  def host_hook; end
end
